&Enable automatic update checks.text: Activer les &vérifications de mise à jour

&Require client certificate (mTLS; only.text: &Exiger un certificat client (mTLS ; seulement si CA défini)

'token' / 'mtls' / 'both' apply to admin.text: 'token' / 'mtls' / 'both' apply to admin API auth. Agent HMAC: dual_mode accepts unsigned during soak; required rejects unsigned (flip only after agents set hmac_signing_mode=required); disabled is emergency rollback.

Add trust &key id:.text: Ajouter un ID de clé de &confiance :

Advertised &host (FQDN, hostname, or IP).text: &Hôte annoncé (FQDN, nom d'hôte ou IP). Vide = revenir à la découverte.

Capture &backtrace on warn-level events.text: Capturer la &backtrace sur les avertissements (coût perf)

Cert / key paths can be absolute or rela.text: Cert / key paths can be absolute or relative to the server's working directory. The CA path is a PEM bundle of CAs trusted to sign client certificates; leave blank to disable client-cert verification.

Comma-separated metadata keys for CEF/LE.text: Comma-separated metadata keys for CEF/LEEF/plain extensions (e.g. tenant_guid).

Emit operational events to the Windows &.text: Émettre les événements opérationnels dans le journal d'&événements Windows

Global syslog transport: Settings -> Sys.text: Global syslog transport: Settings -> Syslog Forwarding. Global webhook: manifest keys EVENTS_WEBHOOK_*.

Grant trust and device enrollment (read-.text: Confiance grant et enrollment appareil (lecture seule) :

Hook bundle scripts and propagation disc.text: Hook bundle scripts and propagation discovery are configured on the Agent configurator (Settings menu), not on this server program.

Identity used by the SCM service / syste.text: Identité utilisée par le service SCM / l'unité systemd :

Magnification scales text and layout (sa.text: Magnification scales text and layout (same as A- / 100% / A+). Stored per user (HKCU).

Scale and language are under View, Fonts.text: L'échelle et la langue sont sous Affichage, Polices et tailles. Enregistrement par utilisateur.

Manage endpoint &identities in web UI....text: Gérer les &identités d'endpoint dans l'interface Web...

Note: changes apply on next 'Reinstall s.text: Note: changes apply on next 'Reinstall service'. Password is stored as a secret in the OS vault. Linux ignores the password (use systemd User=).

OTEL settings are written to platform st.text: OTEL settings are written to platform storage and surfaced to the daemon on next start. Manifest keys: EVENT_LOG_ENABLED, OTEL_ENABLED, OTEL_ENDPOINT, OTEL_SAMPLE_RATE, OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, STACKTRACE_ON_WARN.

POST /api/admin/mitm/start -- launches m.text: POST /api/admin/mitm/start -- launches mitmweb in reverse-proxy mode.

POST /api/admin/server/config -- trigger.text: POST /api/admin/server/config -- triggers a restart on the offline server.

PUT /api/admin/server-identity. Empty ho.text: PUT /api/admin/server-identity. Empty host re-runs discovery on the server.

Paste the PEM-encoded private key (BEGIN.text: Paste the PEM-encoded private key (BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY):

Paste the PEM-encoded server certificate.text: Paste the PEM-encoded server certificate (BEGIN CERTIFICATE...):

Per-event syslog routing lives in events.text: Per-event syslog routing lives in events-routing.json (Event Sharing). TCP-TLS uses SYSLOG_CA_FILE and SYSLOG_TLS_SNI_HOST from saved platform storage — save those keys before Test syslog.

Public URL is the externally-reachable b.text: Public URL is the externally-reachable base URL clients will register against (typically https://offline.example.com/). HTTP and TLS ports are the listeners the daemon binds; restart the service after changing them.

RUST_LOG (when set in the service enviro.text: RUST_LOG (when set in the service environment) overrides LOG_LEVEL. Time zone applies to every log line emitted by the daemon.

Require &MFA on admin login (forwarded t.text: Require &MFA on admin login (forwarded to identity provider; reserved for future use)

Restart the offline server service after.text: Restart the offline server service after Save (Service menu -> Restart Server (live), or sc.exe stop/start). When the server is running, pick a registered HSM connection to pre-fill module path and slot ID (or register connections in the web admin Settings -> HSM (/settings/hsm)).

Restart the server to pick up this chang.text: Restart the server to pick up this change in already-running log files; new files use the new format immediately.

Select an event type, then toggle built-.text: Select an event type, then toggle built-in sinks. Writes %PROGRAMDATA%\\AIC\\OfflinePimServer\\events-routing.json. The server reloads this file on the next settings refresh heartbeat (or restart).

Selects which CryptoAdapter backs server.text: Selects which CryptoAdapter backs server-side application crypto (DB column encryption, settings.json wrapping, audit-log signing, KEK custody). Wire-protocol HMAC, body SHA-256, and agent-side PBKDF2 stay on the in-process AWS-LC FIPS module regardless of this choice (always-local per the enterprise-compliance contract).

Subject Alt Names (one host or IP per li.text: Subject Alt Names (one host or IP per line). Empty = server defaults to localhost.

The default tenant is the bucket into wh.text: The default tenant is the bucket into which new offline agents enroll when they do not present a tenant_guid; auto-provisioning lets unknown agents create their own tenant on first contact.
